name: Amazon Redshift
description: Amazon Redshift (provisioned and serverless). Inherits the PostgreSQL connection settings and replaces the catalog queries Redshift does not support (array constructors, pg_depend lineage) with SVV views. A connection configured as postgresql switches to this definition automatically when the server says it is Redshift. Not yet run against a real cluster.

version.sql: select version() as banner, null as version

databases.sql: select database_name as name, database_owner as owner from svv_redshift_databases order by 1

alternatives.sql: select datname as name from pg_database where not datistemplate order by 1

schemas.sql: select schema_name as name, schema_owner as owner from svv_all_schemas where database_name = current_database() order by 1

sql: select t.table_name as name, case t.table_type when 'VIEW' then 'view' when 'EXTERNAL TABLE' then 'external_table' else 'table' end as type,
i.tbl_rows as row_count, i.size * 1048576 as size_bytes, t.remarks as comment
from svv_all_tables t
left join svv_table_info i on i.schema = t.schema_name and i."table" = t.table_name
where t.database_name = current_database() and t.schema_name = {{schema}} [[and t.table_name > {{after}}]]
order by t.table_name
limit {{limit|int}}
select table_name as dataset, ordinal_position as ordinal, column_name as name, data_type as data_type,
is_nullable as nullable, column_default as default_value, remarks as comment,
character_maximum_length as max_length, numeric_precision as numeric_precision, numeric_scale as numeric_scale
from svv_all_columns
where database_name = current_database() and schema_name = {{schema}} and table_name in ({{datasets}})
order by table_name, ordinal_position
select tc.table_name as dataset, tc.constraint_name as name, lower(replace(tc.constraint_type, ' ', '_')) as type,
k.column_name as columns, k.ordinal_position as seq
from information_schema.table_constraints tc
join information_schema.key_column_usage k
on k.constraint_schema = tc.constraint_schema and k.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
where tc.table_schema = {{schema}} and tc.table_name in ({{datasets}})
and tc.constraint_type in ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE', 'FOREIGN KEY')
order by 1, 2, 5

principals.sql: select usename as name, 'user' as type, usesuper as superuser from pg_user order by 1
